findings.summary: The bootstrap trusts stored statuses in an assessment whose digest and reviewed Git blob are not pinned, rather than recomputing R01-R14 from hash-pinned evidence.
An imported caller can invoke execute_from_bootstrap with a forgeable dictionary attestation and bypass bootstrap integrity, Git binding, and static-gate checks.
The semantic four-artifact verifier exists but the successful execution path does not call it before reporting success.
The consumption marker is under a same-user mutable /temp output directory, so deletion permits replay without an external append-only or permission-protected ledger.
The bootstrap does not require the PASS receipt to attest the exact review scope and false blind-data-read and real-unseal-executed flags.

passed_checks: reviewed commit resolved to HEAD and the checkout was clean
all seven pinned artifact digests matched working files and reviewed Git blobs
stdlib-only bootstrap preceded dynamic project imports
source inventories were rehashed after durable CONSUMED and before parsing
R07 retained MISSING_RESULT_PATH in its denominator
released schema excluded candidate-level paths run IDs times and outcomes
eight focused v6 tests and all 122 repository tests passed
required_disposition: Preserve v6 as failed review evidence. Do not unseal. Remediate only in v7 after establishing a digest-bound gate snapshot, an unbypassable entry path, integrated release verification, exact review receipt validation, and an external append-only or permission-protected consumption ledger.
